## What to Expect

The DSBE Forum brings together current students, alumni, and faculty for an evening of exchange, industry perspectives, and community. We are excited to have [Dr. Armin Müller](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dr-armin-müller-97281250/) kick off the event with an opening keynote, followed by an open Q&A and discussion.

> ### "Driving AI Transformation in Large Enterprises"
> **Dr. Armin Müller**  
> *Global Head of Data & AI @ Kaufland*

* **Cross-Cohort Exchange:** Connect with former classmates, meet newer DSBE cohorts, and discuss career paths and industry experiences.
* **Dinner & Drinks:** Wrapping up the evening together at a local Tübingen restaurant (self-pay), followed by drinks in the old town.

> **Venue & Details:** The exact lecture hall and restaurant location will be announced closer to the event date. Please RSVP via the registration button above to secure your spot, and check back on this website anytime for the latest updates.
